how_it_picks: With ?season=<id> in the URL the page previews that look. Otherwise the look whose window holds the current Pasadena date; overlapping windows go to the shortest; with no window open, maison.
what_a_look_may_change: Colour variables (accent, canvas, hairline, notice ground), one decorative motif layer on the hero, the dated greeting line in the hero, and the seasonal shelf on the home page: a selection of items already on the menu at their menu prices. Never a new product, a changed price, hours, layout or buying copy. Ruling 2 of 25 Oct 2026 kept; the shelf is curation, not a new product set.
how_owners_switch: In the build: one theme setting (Theme settings > Season: Auto, or a named look) read by Liquid, so nothing flashes and a look reverts when its window closes. In this concept: assets/season.js reads the same windows before first paint.
generated_files: tools/regen_static.py writes assets/seasons.css and the window table inside assets/season.js from this file; run it (or --check) before every publish.
